parameters.note: Channel Lake is a high alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.), on the west side of the Sierra crest in the South Fork American River drainage — NHD reach code 18020129001142, California hydrologic region 18 (Sacramento/San Joaquin), NOT the Lake Tahoe / Truckee basin (Great Basin region 16). It is therefore not a Lake Tahoe tributary, so the Lake Tahoe tributary catch-and-release closure in CCR §7.50(b)(152) does not apply. Channel Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1) governs (open all year, 5-trout daily / 10-trout possession).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not a special-regulation water and not a Lake Tahoe tributary)

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.counting_rule: General statewide trout limit for inland lakes, reservoirs, and ponds: five-trout daily bag limit and ten-trout possession limit. No trout stocking or self-sustaining fishery is documented for this lake in current CDFW sources; the limit is the governing legal maximum, not an indication that fish are present.

candidates.summary: 5 trout daily bag limit, 10 trout possession limit (general statewide default)
